sourceFile: 65. TIU C11-20  Report Test  NEW grill 2026.2.14_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has usable result evidence but misgroups the changed factor and lacks a clear baseline for improvement.
issues: Primary changed factor should be new grill change, not sample/shift conditions.
Baseline condition is not explicit or cited.
Sample frequency, OK/NG sample, and shift appear to be subgroups, not changed factors.
Improvement claim is unsupported without pre-change comparison rows.
Rows Test!20, Test!22, and Test!24 are cited but not shown in context text.
requiredUserQuestions: Is there any pre-new-grill baseline evidence in the workbook?
Should all sample types and shifts be treated as subgroups under the new grill test?
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to use/change to new grill for TIU C11-20.
Mark baseline as not cited unless pre-change rows exist.
Move frequency, sample status, and shift into subgroup keys.
Keep one function-defect outcome with all result rows cited.
Use decision row only as conclusion, not proof of baseline improvement.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations are row-level but insufficient until missing cited row text and baseline evidence are verified.
